text:
deploy-bot: kicking off config-only rollout — routing weight shift + batch cap tweak. Canary 7% for 18m. Change window 19:00-21:00 UTC. Patch: prefer eu-west by +10%, reduce batch_max_tokens=20, per_router_concurrency=6, request_timeout_ms=1500. Health posts every 4m.

ryan: quick note — no model pins, this is pure routing/batching. Exclude loadtest-tenant and infra-lab from canary.

lana: agreed exclusions. Rollback triggers: abort if eu p99 > 1100ms OR error_rate increases by >1.0% absolute OR infra OOMs >=2 in 15m. Also monitor kv_cache_miss and shard_queue_length.

ryan: ops snippet:
```yaml
change: config-only
canary: 7pct for 18m -> step to 25% if green
routing_weights:
  eu-west-1: +10
  us-east-1: -6
batching:
  max_tokens: 20
  per_router_concurrency: 6
timeouts_ms: 1500
exclude: [loadtest-tenant, infra-lab]
rollback_triggers:
  eu_p99_ms: 1100
  error_rate_abs_pct: 1.0
  infra_ooms_15m: 2
```

deploy-bot: canary started at 2026-04-12T19:02:47Z. Observability links: /dash/route-weights, /dash/batch-health. Paging to @lana and @ryan on alerts.

(4m) sre-bot: health check: eu p50 68ms p95 340ms p99 910ms, error_rate +0.2%, kv_cache_miss +0.3% — within guardrails.

(16m) ryan: one host hit OOM and was drained, autoscaler replaced it, no client-visible errors.

lana: green to step to 25%. Publishing release note: "Config-only: routing pref eu-west +10, batch_max_tokens 20, per-router concurrency 6, request timeout 1500ms. Canary 7% -> 25% on green. Exclusions: loadtest-tenant, infra-lab. Rollback if eu p99>1100ms, error rate +1.0% abs, or >=2 infra OOMs in 15m."

deploy-bot: next automated health post in 4m. Commands: `/deploybot abort-config` to revert, `/deploybot show-exclusions`.
